canonical_name: Suppliers Not Known and Prioritized by Criticality
description: Suppliers are not known and prioritized by criticality.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of a complete supplier inventory or lack of criticality classification for suppliers. Check for missing documentation of critical vs. non-critical suppliers or absence of prioritization mechanisms.
